events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You’re talking to an AI assistant, not a person. I don’t have a verified model name or visibility into who may review this chat. I can reset your password and send a reset link to your registered phone.

To speak with a person at the service desk, call **extension 4400, 7am–7pm**.
